subject: Re: DPIA questionnaire submission & evidence for Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Amelia Johnson <amelia.johnson@caremorehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: privacy@caremorehealth.com
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: DPIA questionnaire: Redwood Inference — CareMore Health

Hello Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is CareMore's DPIA template — we use it for vendor assessments when processing any category of personal data. We're hoping to get your completed responses plus supporting evidence (SOC2 report, subprocessors list, network/data-flow diagrams, and any SCCs/contractual wording if available) by end of next week if possible.

A few clarifying points up front:
- We'll need confirmation of whether Redwood will process any PHI/PII that would be considered health data under GDPR/HIPAA.
- Please note our privacy team will want the data flow diagram to show how PII enters, where it's stored, and which subprocessors access it.
- If you rely on standard contractual clauses, please include the exact version and whether you support EU data residency or region restrictions.

Attached: CareMore_DPIA_Template_20260518.xlsx

Appreciate your help — if you need a short call to walk through the template, we can make time this week.

Best,
Amelia
Amelia Johnson
Vendor Risk Lead, CareMore Health

Subject: Re: DPIA questionnaire: Redwood Inference — CareMore Health

Hi Amelia — thanks for the template and the clear checklist. We're on it.

Quick plan:
- Marissa (Privacy) will take lead on the DPIA template and populate the fields.
- Rishi (Security) will pull together the SOC2 pack, the network/data-flow diagram, and confirm encryption/KMS details.
- I'll coordinate answers on subprocessors, SCCs, and any contractual language.

Two quick clarifications that will affect some answers:
1) Do you expect Redwood to sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) under HIPAA? If you're planning to transmit or persist PHI, we'll need to confirm scope and posture.
2) Do you require that processing be restricted to EU data centers only, or is cross-border processing permitted under SCCs?

Tentative timeline: we'll return a completed template + evidence pack by 2026-05-20 (48 hours) if the scope is limited to metadata and non-PHI, otherwise we'll need until 2026-05-25.

We'll attach supporting docs as we collect them.

— Soojin

Thanks Soojin — quick clarifications:
- We're not expecting PHI for the initial pilot; the data set will be de-identified patient engagement metrics and user-entered free text that should be treated as pseudonymized. No BAA required for this phase, but we may revisit for broader rollout.
- EU residency is preferred but not mandatory; SCCs will be required for any cross-border transfers.

Deadline: internal privacy sign-off target is 2026-05-25, but an earlier submission would be very helpful.

I'll keep an eye out for the evidence pack and can set up a 30-minute review call for 2026-05-21 if you'd like.

Best,
Amelia

Hi Amelia — attaching our completed responses and an evidence bundle for your review. Per Soojin's note, because the pilot uses de-identified/pseudonymized metrics, no BAA is required at this stage. We've still included our standard SCC language and confirmation of support for EU data residency via regional endpoints where requested.

Highlights:
- Completed template: Redwood_DPIA_Response_20260520.pdf (answers mapped to your sections, with references to attachments).
- Evidence: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (full attestation), redwood_subprocessors_202605.csv (names + purpose + locations), network_dataflow_diagram.png, encryption_and_key_management_whitepaper.pdf.
- Retention & deletion: default retention for customer data is 90 days unless otherwise contractually agreed; we can support shorter retention windows for the pilot.
- Access controls & RKMS: keys are customer-isolated in KMS with CMK rotation; details in whitepaper.
- SCCs: included excerpt and a pointer to the clause where we accept controller-to-processor SCCs; full templated language available in the Drive link below.

Attachments: Redwood_DPIA_Response_20260520.pdf; Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf; redwood_subprocessors_202605.csv; network_dataflow_diagram.png; encryption_and_key_management_whitepaper.pdf
